title: The Thing Said
label: ch:ml-ennu
canDo: I can report what somebody said, thought, knew or asked, by putting the quotative ennu after a sentence I can already say.

payoff.summary: From cold: the marker that turns any sentence into the thing said, and the four verbs it can hand that sentence to — with nothing inside the quoted sentence rebuilt.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these two atoms and the payoff assesses both. The saying-verb this chapter is built on moved to chapter 50, where the corpus had been using it since the farewell lesson without teaching it.
